notes: Legacy reference manifest for the old Pixabay-based fetch workflow.
Public alpha releases should prefer the bundled/generated Core Sound Pack in sounds/library/ and sounds/sound_library.json.
scripts/fetch_media.py is kept only as a compatibility/helper script for old fixed ambience filenames in sounds/.
The TODO download_url values are intentional placeholders; this file is not required for normal install or release testing.
Do not treat this manifest as the primary media path for Nocturne alpha.7 or later.
